# Armaan Farshori

> Founder of Cyvire, a hiring platform built only for cybersecurity. Technical
> program manager with seven years running security and compliance programmes
> that pass audits. Based in Greater Noida, India.

## Who

Armaan Farshori is a cybersecurity program leader and founder. He has spent
seven years delivering security programmes across consulting (Deloitte,
Fortreum), product companies (Delhivery) and government (CDAC, including
Ministry of Defence projects). He is currently a Technical Program Manager
at Fortreum and the founder of Cyvire.

## Cyvire

Cyvire is a cybersecurity-only hiring platform, in build as of 2026. It
matches security practitioners and teams on evidence (programmes delivered,
frameworks passed, incidents handled) rather than resume keywords.

## Expertise

- Compliance frameworks: FedRAMP, FISMA, CMMC, NIST 800-53, ISO 27001,
  SOC 2, GDPR, DPDP Act
- Cloud security on AWS and GCP; detection and response / SOC operations
- Programme delivery: stakeholder management, RAID logs, executive
  reporting, audit readiness, evidence pipelines
- Tooling: Microsoft Sentinel, SIEM/SOAR, Ansible, Linux, Fortinet

## Track record

- Technical Program Manager, Fortreum (2026 to present)
- Deputy Manager, Cyber Defence & Resilience, Deloitte (2025 to 2026)
- Program Manager, Cyber Security, Delhivery (2021 to 2025): 95% of
  critical vulnerabilities closed within SLA, operational risk down 40%
- Project Engineer / Associate, CDAC (2021): Ministry of Defence delivery
- Lead Technical Consultant, Precise Technologies, Dubai (2019 to 2021)

## Credentials

- ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity (2025 to 2028); CISSP in progress
- CDAC Scientist Level B exam cleared (MeitY, Government of India)
- Alden Global Top 50 Cybersecurity Professional, North India
- MCA (Amity University), BCA (Kalinga University)
